newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Ross Mining in gold mine land title pact.
newsitem.headline: Ross Mining in gold mine land title pact.

text.p: Ross Mining NL said on Tuesday it expects to start production at its Timbarra gold mine in New South Wales state in February 1998 after reaching agreement with local Aboriginal tribes.
A Ross spokesman said the agreement with the Tabulam Bunjalung people over native title issues would allow the mine to produce at an annual rate of about 55,000 ounces over an initial 10 years.
A feasibility study indicated cash costs at the mine would average about A$265 an ounce, the spokesman said.
Gold currently fetches A$440 an ounce.
Recent exploration results at Timbarra include 26 metres grading 1.62 grams of gold per tonne of ore and 20 metres grading 1.41 grams/t, the spokesman said.
